coverage: Worldwide config/global_bounds.json (lon -180..180, lat -90..90, 3600x1800) + NA nest. No shoreline cut. Gaps transparent.
display_units: 5-75 dBZ severity on two ramps (Rain: green->purple; Snow/Sleet: pale blue->purple); type from MRMS PrecipFlag / ECCC SfcPrecipType / GFS CSNOW-CICEP
eccc_units: rain mm/h, snow cm/h (precipitation RATE, not dBZ — not numerically interchangeable with MRMS)
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB + ECCC NA radar, 2-6 min mosaic)

iem_effective_domain.note: Effective CONUS WSR-88D network coverage inside the advertised bbox (lon -171..170, lat 5..70). Footprint of the CONUS radar source (MRMS SeamlessHSR, same WSR-88D network as the old IEM N0Q mosaic); also gates GFS model fill.

mrms_product: MRMS_SeamlessHSR_00.00 (NOAA/NSSL hybrid-scan reflectivity composite, dBZ; -999 missing, -99 no-echo; 2-min cadence) — CONUS and regional Alaska / Hawaii / Caribbean domains
precedence: ECCC rain (rates -> dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4 onto the shared severity scale) wins everywhere its RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV dynamic coverage is valid, including most of CONUS; ECCC snow classes (SfcPrecipType) render on the Snow/Sleet ramp; NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB: measured dBZ -> severity ramps, PrecipFlag class 3 -> Snow/Sleet ramp) fills ECCC gaps; OPERA EU DBZH fills remaining non-NA radar gaps on the Rain ramp (no type product); JMA nowcast intensity (mm/h classes) fills Japan gaps via Z-R equivalents on the Rain ramp (no type product); GFS model estimates (CSNOW/CICEP -> Snow/Sleet ramp, CRAIN/CFRZR -> Rain ramp) only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere.
source_name: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
title: LIVE PRECIPITATION
variable: MRMS SeamlessHSR base reflectivity dBZ (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) + MRMS PrecipFlag surface type; ECCC precipitation-rate rain (mm/h)/snow (cm/h) mapped to dBZ through the ECCC 14-color class rates with the NWS Z=300R^1.4 equivalence (equal ECCC colors = equal severity = equal dBZ). One 5-75 dBZ severity scale rendered on two ramps that match the NOAA/CSU MRMS event-loop legend: Rain (green->purple) and Snow/Sleet (pale blue->purple).
visual_note: MRMS reflectivity rendered on the shared severity scale in its domains (measured dBZ -> ramp position; PrecipFlag snow class 3 -> Snow/Sleet ramp). ECCC rain and snow mapped to the same scale by class severity (snow classes -> Snow/Sleet ramp). GFS model estimates (CSNOW/CICEP snow, CRAIN/CFRZR rain) render on the same ramps in verified radar gaps (disclosed as model output in metadata). OPERA/JMA publish no type here, so their echoes stay on the Rain ramp. Type is never guessed from color or climatology. Equal colors across the transition do NOT claim identical measurements.
